source_text: Empirical medical evidence indicates that male circumcision reduces risks of urinary tract infections in infancy, penile cancer, and heterosexual HIV acquisition by up to 60% in high-prevalence areas, with benefits outweighing rare complications like bleeding or adhesions when performed neonatally under sterile conditions. [3] [4]
